title: Insurance Tracking Standard — Hazard Coverage, Lapse Notices and Lender-Placed Premium on Home Purchase Financing Loans
content:
**Standard of the insurance tracking unit, Hearthstone Home Finance**

**Requirement.** The home must carry hazard coverage of not less than the unpaid principal, with Hearthstone Home Finance named as loss payee, for the life of a Home Purchase Financing loan.

**Lapse.** When coverage lapses the insurance status becomes lapsed, a first lapse notice is sent and a reminder follows; the reminder may be sent no earlier than the program's first-notice period less its reminder period after the first notice.

**Lender-placed premium — notice period.** A lender-placed premium may be charged no earlier than the program's first-notice period counted from the first lapse notice date. The notice period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the first notice date, and the premium may be charged on the last day of the period; a reminder must also have been sent at least the program's reminder period before the charge. The dates are read from the lapse notices the company has recorded on that loan.

**Nature of lender-placed coverage.** Lender-placed coverage protects only the lender's interest in the home, costs more than coverage the borrower buys, and is cancelled when the borrower proves their own coverage.

**Proof of the borrower's own coverage.** When the borrower proves coverage with a policy that names Hearthstone Home Finance as loss payee — a Hearthstone Insurance Agency policy on the home in force (Manufactured Home Insurance), or a declarations page from another insurer — the insurance status returns to in force and lender-placed premium for any period the borrower's own policy covered is refunded to escrow within the program's refund period in calendar days.

### Notice-period cases (hypothetical dates; periods taken as 45 days and 15 days)

- First lapse notice dated 2026-01-10. Day 1 of the period is 2026-01-11 and day 45 is 2026-02-24.
- A charge on 2026-02-24 — the last day of the period — meets the notice period; a charge on 2026-02-23 does not.
- The reminder may be sent no earlier than 45 less 15, that is 30, days after the first notice, so no earlier than 2026-02-09; for a charge on 2026-02-24 it must have been sent at least 15 days before, so no later than 2026-02-09.
